scope: Authored coverage assessment for this corpus, not a literature-exhaustiveness claim or scientific truth score

rows.label: B10 · Surface reactions to a coupled reaction front
rows.observations: W06 preserves a hydrothermal bulk-rate range with its regime; no calibrated phase-specific reaction-front series.
rows.measuredInputs: Reported core mass-loss range; no measured dissolved/particulate split.
rows.distinguishingTests: Proposed mass-partition, time and surface-profile comparison.
gaps: Phase-specific rates, reactive area, saturation and product-layer transport.
Trial-level uncertainty, evolving reactive area, saturation and precipitation.

rows.label: B11 · Material processes to mineral and rock history
rows.observations: W06 transcribes static powder residue XRD and demonstrates the changing denominator.
rows.measuredInputs: Four normalized phase-composition rows; no monument-specific phase inventory.
rows.distinguishingTests: Proposed matched phase/fabric and source-rock comparison.
gaps: Named component, specimen identity and quantitative phase inventory.
Compatible absolute residue yield and phase basis; gross dissolution versus reprecipitation.

rows.label: B15 · Material capability to a human process protocol
rows.observations: W06 distinguishes chemical assistance from accepted shape and retained strength.
rows.measuredInputs: Modern laboratory rate context; no accepted shaping-yield or archaeological productivity series.
rows.distinguishingTests: Proposed treatment/control throughput and quality comparison.
gaps: Shared resources, setup, losses, fuel/reagent supply and accepted yield.
Matched thermal/mechanical baseline, mass closure, surface quality and retained strength.

rows.label: B17 · Environment to preserved archaeological signature
rows.observations: W03 considers preservation and later overprints; W05 audits spatial context.
rows.measuredInputs: Five located Ca/P entries are transcribed for one reported sample context; no survival probabilities estimated.
rows.distinguishingTests: Proposed profile, background and chronology comparison.
gaps: Trace survival, sampling coverage, contamination history and dating.

rows.label: B18 · Material archive to calibrated records
rows.observations: W05 audits reported specimen identity and source-to-transcription mapping.
rows.measuredInputs: Figure 15 Ca/P entries checked visually; inherited Harrell attribution retained.
rows.distinguishingTests: Proposed matched-region measurement and raw-spectrum return.
gaps: Raw spectra, analytical uncertainty, detection limit and exact inset coordinates.

rows.label: B19 · Preserved records to historical alternatives
rows.observations: W03/W05 keep measured features separate from competing histories.
rows.measuredInputs: Located chemistry supports a restricted comparison; it does not independently identify an ancient event.
rows.distinguishingTests: Proposed co-registered fabric/phase/chronology discriminator.
gaps: Diagnostic specificity, dates and correspondence between analyzed fragments.

rows.label: B20 · Experimental replication to historical support
rows.observations: W02/W04 separate modern feasibility and controls from historical occurrence.
rows.measuredInputs: No new replication experiment and no historical treatment attribution.
rows.distinguishingTests: Proposed independently replicated, blocked treatment comparisons.
gaps: Real response data, uncertainty, process feasibility and contextual ancient evidence.

rows.label: B23 · Chemical alteration and mechanical work to removal
rows.observations: W06 defines material, energy and accepted-output ledgers for process comparison.
rows.measuredInputs: No complete measured process inventory, building saving or abatement estimate.
rows.distinguishingTests: Proposed heat/alkali/mechanical factorial with mass partition.
gaps: Mineral-specific attack, crack evolution and useful removal under equal work.
Reagent recovery, equipment, heating/pumping, waste, local comparator and accepted yield.
